title: Figure 19: Stereographic Projection – sphere projected onto a grid plane
description: Three-dimensional rendering of a shaded sphere with latitude-longitude lines resting on a flat square grid. A red circle on the sphere is projected from the north pole onto a red circle on the plane. The caption reads "Figure 19. Stereographic Projection"; the text links it to Maxwell's fish-eye lens and non-Euclidean optical materials.
